She is also separating the Sunday timeline in memory into three distinct parts, now consolidated as: 10:25 to 10:40 return, 11:50 to 12:05 ST-9 steamer setup, and the restricted late-Sunday resident-only movement (late Sunday after 6, no exact minute), with broad private wording only.
